tasks.title: Create build.mjs input, validation and output pipeline

acceptance_criteria.text: `build.mjs` exists at the project root and imports only `node:` builtins (`grep -E "from ['\"][^n]" build.mjs` prints nothing) (covers: REQ-11)
`node build.mjs` reads `content.json` from the working directory and writes `dist/index.html`, exit 0 (covers: REQ-1)
the output is one file, `index.html`, inside the output directory, which is created when absent (covers: REQ-2)
with `CONTENT_FILE=<tmp>/c.json OUT_DIR=<tmp>/out`, the script reads `<tmp>/c.json` and writes `<tmp>/out/index.html` and nothing else (covers: REQ-14)
`package.json` declares no `dependencies` and the script makes no network call (no `node:http`, `node:https`, `node:net`, `fetch` in `build.mjs`) (covers: REQ-11)
the content file's bytes are identical before and after a run (covers: REQ-13)
`CONTENT_FILE` naming a missing file → exit 1, exactly one stderr line naming the path, no `index.html` written (covers: REQ-18)
a content file holding `{not json` → exit 1, exactly one stderr line, no `index.html` written (covers: REQ-18)
content with no `name`, `name: 42` or `name: ""` → exit 1, exactly one stderr line naming `name`, no `index.html` written (covers: REQ-19)
on every error path the output directory is not created when it did not exist (covers: REQ-18)

tasks.title: Render the personal page as escaped, script-free, deterministic HTML

acceptance_criteria.text: the content model `name`, `tagline`, `about`, `projects[{title, summary, url}]`, `contact{email}` is read; only `name` is required (covers: REQ-4)
the page's only `<h1>` is `name` and the tagline follows it (covers: REQ-5)
an About section renders `about` as one paragraph (covers: REQ-6)
a Projects section renders one card per project, title linked to `url` (covers: REQ-7)
a Contact section renders a `mailto:` link to `contact.email` (covers: REQ-8)
`<title>` is `name` (covers: REQ-9)
sections appear in the order h1+tagline → About → Projects → Contact (covers: REQ-10)
the CSS is one inline `<style>` in `<head>`; no `<link>` element (covers: REQ-3)
the output contains no `<script`, no ` on…=` attribute and no `javascript:` (a `javascript:` url renders its title as plain text) (covers: REQ-12)
two runs over the same content give byte-identical files (covers: REQ-20)
a project with no `url` (or an empty one) renders its title with no `<a>`; the page has no `href="#"` and no `href=""` (covers: REQ-15)
`projects: []` or no `projects` → "Projects are coming soon." and no `<ul>`/`<ol>`/`<li>` (covers: REQ-16)
a missing `tagline`, `about`, `summary` or `contact` renders empty, with no `undefined` or `null` text in the page (covers: REQ-4)
a title `Rock & Roll` appears as `<b>Rock & Roll</b>`; `"` and `'` are escaped inside `href` values (covers: REQ-17)

tasks.title: Write the node --test suite over the UC-BuildPage Test Surface

acceptance_criteria.text: `test/build.test.mjs` exists and `node --test test/build.test.mjs` exits 0 reporting more than 0 tests (covers: REQ-21)
every test spawns `node build.mjs` with `CONTENT_FILE`/`OUT_DIR` set to a fresh `fs.mkdtempSync` directory and never touches the project's own `content.json` or `dist/` (covers: REQ-14)

the suite has one named test per Test Surface row: TS-INV-01 … TS-INV-07, TS-ERR-CONTENT_MISSING, TS-ERR-CONTENT_UNPARSEABLE, TS-REQ-name-missing, TS-REQ-name-type, TS-NOGO-01, TS-NOGO-02 (covers: REQ-21)
the error-path tests assert exit code 1, exactly one non-empty stderr line, and no `index.html` (covers: REQ-18)
the determinism test compares two runs byte for byte (covers: REQ-20)
